description: The hall’s top unit, a half-floor above its neighbours: a fold-away bed, a slim galley, and a window that turns the basin into weather you watch from above. Quiet, expensive, and empty until now.

window.description: A wide, clean pane with the district laid out below it, close enough to read the signage.
window.name: the window
